_comment: English body for prompt-case-summarize-long. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output an overview, section points and open questions; each point carries a paragraph locator.
Inputs: Long source text, section structure, and summary length limit.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Summarise the source. Output overview, sections[] (heading, points[], locator), and open_questions[]. Each point must come from its paragraph; locator gives section/paragraph number. Do not turn future work into completed conclusions. Keep total length under {limit}.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.检查点:
- Each point has a locator and can be traced.
- Future work remains in open_questions.
- Length stays under the limit.
sections.失败分支:
- Opinions enter the summary: remove evaluative sentences.
- Missing locators: add paragraph numbers or re-section.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
